steps.message:
## Diagnosis

The Info page (`InfoActivity` → `content_info.xml`) shows a single `TextView` bound to `@string/large_text`. That string held a hand-copied, **truncated** GPL v3: it stopped at

```
"0. Definitions:"
"\"This License\" refers to version 3 of the GNU General Public License.\n"
"..."
```

so scrolling to the bottom of the Info page showed `...` instead of the license.

The obvious fix — pasting the full 35 KB license into `large_text` — **does not work**. I verified this with the SDK's own `aapt2`: a string resource larger than 32 KB is silently replaced at link time, so the Info page would have rendered the literal placeholder text:

```
error: string too large to encode using UTF-8 written instead as 'STRING_TOO_LARGE'.
resource 0x7f020005 string/large_text  () "STRING_TOO_LARGE"
```

This platform limit is almost certainly why the license was abbreviated in the first place.

## Fix

1. **`app/src/main/res/raw/license_gpl_v3.txt` (new)** — the complete GNU GPL v3 (the project's own root `LICENSE`, 674 lines, through `END OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS` and the appendix), stored as a raw resource where no size limit applies.
2. **`InfoActivity.java`** — loads the raw resource and sets it on the license `TextView`, prefixed with the `License - GPL V 3.0` heading; stream handling is closed in `finally` and falls back to the XML text if reading ever fails.
3. **`content_info.xml`** — gave the existing `TextView` the id `licenseTextView` (no other layout/behavior change).
4. **`strings.xml`** — `large_text` is now a short, valid fallback (title, copyright/verbatim notice, link to the full license) instead of a truncated document, plus a new `license_title` string.

## Verification

A full `./gradlew assembleDebug` can't run in this environment — the network is closed and AGP 3.1.4 isn't in the local Gradle cache, so dependency resolution fails before any compilation (this is environmental, unrelated to the patch). I therefore validated both halves of the build directly with the installed SDK/JDK:

- `aapt2 compile --dir app/src/main/res` → **ALL RESOURCES COMPILE OK**, and `aapt2 link` now emits no `STRING_TOO_LARGE` error; the dump confirms `raw/license_gpl_v3` is packaged and `unzip`-ing it from the APK shows the license ending correctly at `why-not-lgpl.html` with `END OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS` present.
- `javac` (Temurin 8, `android-28` bootclasspath + the cached support-library jars) compiles `InfoActivity.java` with **no errors**.

Result: opening Menu → Info and scrolling to the end now shows the license in full.

```
"\"This License\" refers to version 3 of the GNU General Public License.\n"
"..."
```

so scrolling to the bottom of the Info page showed `...` instead of the license.

The obvious fix — pasting the full 35 KB license into `large_text` — **does not work**. I verified this with the SDK's own `aapt2`: a string resource larger than 32 KB is silently replaced at link time, so the Info page would have rendered the literal placeholder text:

```
error: string too large to encode using UTF-8 written instead as 'STRING_TOO_LARGE'.
resource 0x7f020005 string/large_text  () "STRING_TOO_LARGE"
```

This platform limit is almost certainly why the license was abbreviated in the first place.

## Fix

1. **`app/src/main/res/raw/license_gpl_v3.txt` (new)** — the complete GNU GPL v3 (the project's own root `LICENSE`, 674 lines, through `END OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS` and the appendix), stored as a raw resource where no size limit applies.
2. **`InfoActivity.java`** — loads the raw resource and sets it on the license `TextView`, prefixed with the `License - GPL V 3.0` heading; stream handling is closed in `finally` and falls back to the XML text if reading ever fails.
3. **`content_info.xml`** — gave the existing `TextView` the id `licenseTextView` (no other layout/behavior change).
4. **`strings.xml`** — `large_text` is now a short, valid fallback (title, copyright/verbatim notice, link to the full license) instead of a truncated document, plus a new `license_title` string.

A full `./gradlew assembleDebug` can't run in this environment — the network is closed and AGP 3.1.4 isn't in the local Gradle cache, so dependency resolution fails before any compilation (this is environmental, unrelated to the patch). I therefore validated both halves of the build directly with the installed SDK/JDK:

- `aapt2 compile --dir app/src/main/res` → **ALL RESOURCES COMPILE OK**, and `aapt2 link` now emits no `STRING_TOO_LARGE` error; the dump confirms `raw/license_gpl_v3` is packaged and `unzip`-ing it from the APK shows the license ending correctly at `why-not-lgpl.html` with `END OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS` present.
- `javac` (Temurin 8, `android-28` bootclasspath + the cached support-library jars) compiles `InfoActivity.java` with **no errors**.

Result: opening Menu → Info and scrolling to the end now shows the license in full.
